'''Ciqala''' was a [[Advozse/Legends|Advozse]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the leader of an organized worker rebellion that fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he tasked a Republic spacer to recover useful technology from the mercenary training camps.<ref name="TOR" />
